questions.prompt: Why does Dart's sound null safety NOT automatically promote a nullable instance field `this.name` after `if (name != null)`?

options.text: A getter could be overridden or mutated between checks, so the compiler cannot guarantee it stays non-null

code.source:
final value = this.name;
if (value != null) { print(value.length); }

options.text: A single Dart isolate runs an event loop on one thread, so heavy CPU work blocks UI/network responsiveness

questions.prompt: Why should you avoid `dynamic` in public APIs and domain models?

options.text: `dynamic` disables static type checking, turning compile-time bugs into runtime `NoSuchMethodError`s

Nothing; both allow calling any method

options.text: Windows uses `\` while POSIX uses `/`, so `package:path` handles cross-platform differences cleanly
